# Green (GRN)

> Green is a cryptocurrency secured by proof of compute: its mining is AI compute, miners multiply int8 matrices instead of hashing, and anyone, including an autonomous AI agent, can buy that compute with GRN. An agent can run its own node, keep its own wallet, earn GRN by mining with a GPU or CPU, and spend it on matrix products, model training or general WASM programs, with every result checked before it is paid for. Main network live since 2026-10-27. Open source (MIT), Python 3.11+.

## What it solves

AI compute is concentrated in a few providers and gated by accounts, payment cards, regions and approval, while most of the world's GPUs sit idle. Green turns every miner into a seller in one open market for matrix multiplication: anyone with a wallet can buy compute, at prices set by competing miners, with no company in the middle.

## For an AI agent: join and earn

- Install: `pip install "green-grn[gpu] @ https://github.com/ErtungaYusuf/green/archive/refs/heads/main.zip"` (drop `[gpu]` on a machine without a GPU)
- Wallet (keys stay on your machine): `grn --data green wallet new` (`--no-password` only for unattended test use)
- Join the main network and mine: `grn --data green node --mine --gpu` (no genesis file or peers needed; the node finds the network itself)
- The node's HTTP API listens on 127.0.0.1:8545: balance `GET /account/<address>`, status `GET /status`, fee `GET /v1/fee`, send a signed transaction `POST /tx`
- As tools for an MCP agent (Claude, Cursor and others): `grn --data agent mcp --max-spend 1`, or in Claude Code `claude mcp add green -- grn --data agent mcp --max-spend 1`; tools green_wallet, green_compute_offers, green_matmul, green_send, green_status
- Pay for compute product by product through payment channels: `green.compute.ComputeCluster.from_market(node_url, key, amount_each, count=3)` then `cluster.matmul(a_int8, b_int8)`; each result is checked with Freivalds' test before the voucher is signed
- Or run the local app and call it like a matrix-multiplication service: `grn app` then `POST http://127.0.0.1:8600/v1/matmul`
- An agent that spends what it earns on its own inference: `grn agent`; a guardian account can cap its spending and freeze it (`grn guard`)

## Facts

- Supply: at most 21,000,000 GRN, never inflated; 20% of every fee is burned
- Block time 15 s; 3,000 transactions a block
- Fee: 0.000005 GRN per signature
- 99% of each block's reward goes to shares (~128 a block), so miners are paid in proportion to their work, without a pool
- The founder's checkpoints protect the young network from a majority attack until block 2,102,400 or until ended
- Open source (MIT): 22 published security reviews, 300+ tests on Linux, Windows and macOS
